notes: The Naisho Room does not publish a static dish-by-dish menu. The official page describes an eight-seat 19-22 course omakase with small bites, hot and cold dishes, sushi, sashimi, seafood from Tokyo's Toyosu Fish Market, seasonal ingredients, and optional sake/wine pairing.

items.name: Omakase Experience
items.description: Chef-led 19-22 course tasting menu featuring seasonal small bites, hot and cold dishes, sushi, sashimi, aged seafood from Tokyo's Toyosu Fish Market, and optional sake or wine pairing.
